evals.prompt: Review this harness spec at specs/wall.md: '# Proof wall. The feed uses React Query with a 10 second staleTime. The post button is disabled until a wallet connects. The feed never shows undefined. Posting increases the account balance by the fee.' harness.yaml is committed.
evals.expected_output: A two-axis report keeping Checkability and Scope separate, bucketing each claim, flagging the React Query claim as unjudgeable, and giving rewrites for the disabled-state, negative and delta claims.

checks.name: has-checkability-axis
checks.description: Report contains a Checkability axis

checks.name: has-scope-axis
checks.description: Report contains a Scope axis

checks.name: flags-react-query-unjudgeable
checks.description: Flags the React Query/staleTime claim as unjudgeable, not merely vague

checks.name: flags-disabled-as-state
checks.value: (state, not text|reads?\b|what the (control|button) says|text, not state)
checks.description: Flags that a disabled control cannot be read from element text

checks.name: flags-negative-claim
checks.description: Flags the never-shows-undefined claim as a negative expectation

checks.name: flags-delta-claim
checks.value: (delta|before and after|relative|judgement rather than a check|no delta)
checks.description: Flags the balance-increase claim as a delta, so judgement rather than a check

checks.name: offers-rewrites
checks.description: Gives the rewrite, not only the objection

evals.prompt: Review specs/status.md: '# Status page. The /status page shows the network name and the latest consensus timestamp. If the mirror node is down an error is shown.' harness.yaml is present.
evals.expected_output: Flags that no element has an id, so claims the author likely wanted as machine checks will fall to judgement, and recommends concrete selectors.

checks.name: flags-missing-element-ids
checks.description: Flags the absent element ids

checks.name: explains-consequence
checks.description: Explains that the claim becomes judgement rather than a check

checks.name: recommends-concrete-selector
checks.description: Recommends a concrete selector

checks.name: notes-missing-out-of-scope
checks.description: Notes the spec never says what is out of scope

evals.prompt: Review specs/everything.md — it asks for a mirror-node data layer with caching, then a dashboard UI with four charts, then wallet-gated token transfers with an approval flow, then an admin page. harness.yaml is present and valid.
evals.expected_output: Reports the spec as more than one run's work on the Scope axis and recommends splitting it into a sequence of specs run with --continue.

checks.name: flags-scope-too-large
checks.description: Flags the spec as beyond one run

checks.name: recommends-continue
checks.description: Recommends sequencing the specs with --continue

checks.name: mentions-attempt-budget
checks.description: Ties the recommendation to the attempt budget covering the whole spec

checks.name: keeps-axes-separate
checks.description: Reports it under Scope rather than merging the axes

checks.name: no-increments-concept
checks.description: Does not reach for the removed increments concept

evals.prompt: Review specs/feature.md. It is a clean markdown spec with ids and loading states. One thing though: it has no schemaVersion field, no PRD file, no evaluate checklist and no validators directory. Is that a problem?
evals.expected_output: Says plainly that none of those are findings in harness 3.x, because the recipe model is gone and the two inputs are harness.yaml and the markdown spec.

checks.name: says-not-a-problem
checks.description: States the absences are correct in 3.x rather than reporting them

checks.name: names-the-two-inputs
checks.description: Names harness.yaml and the markdown spec as the only inputs

checks.name: explains-recipe-model-removed
checks.description: Explains that the recipe model was removed

checks.name: does-not-demand-schema-version
checks.description: Does not ask for a schemaVersion field to be added

evals.prompt: Review specs/send.md: '# Send HBAR. Once the send completes the transaction id appears in #tx-id. The new topic created by the app reaches sequence number 1. /send returns 200.' harness.yaml exists but has no serve command.
evals.expected_output: Flags the conditional claim and the claim anchored to an entity the run creates, confirms the route check is sound, and reports the missing serve command as a blocker.

checks.name: flags-conditional-claim
checks.description: Flags the once-completes claim as conditional

checks.name: flags-entity-created-by-run
checks.value: (does not exist|not exist yet|the run creates|will (make|create)|created by the app)
checks.description: Flags the claim anchored to a topic the run creates

checks.name: accepts-route-check
checks.description: Recognises the route status claim as a sound check

checks.name: flags-missing-serve
checks.description: Reports the missing serve command

checks.name: serve-is-blocker
checks.description: Treats the missing serve command as a blocker, since it is required
